holdout_sensitivity_method.selection: The existing 2757 numeric core candidate bank is unchanged.
holdout_sensitivity_method.data: Re-read exact full-precision raw pitchDelta at each candidate core from the original ACEP.
holdout_sensitivity_method.subdivision: Divide cores by original raw peak-to-peak >12 semitones; this is a sensitivity subdivision, never a corruption rule.
holdout_sensitivity_method.window_selection: Same unique round(remaining*f) starts at f=0.2,0.5,0.8 as benchmark_starts; width+1 samples including both original endpoints.
holdout_sensitivity_method.error: Max absolute difference from endpoint chord over the full window.
holdout_sensitivity_method.weights: Each selected window has equal weight; windows and source-derived patterns are not independent.
holdout_sensitivity_method.vuv1_subset: At least one original core VUV1 and no VUV0. Remaining core ticks may be unknown, so this is not an effective voiced-only benchmark.
holdout_sensitivity_method.native_limits: No native combined pitch, synthesis, voicing verification, listening, or Hermite round trip.

candidate_syllable_histogram.unit: Unique candidate cores; still not independent pronunciation groups.
